decision_rule: v2-screen-PASS -> human study -> study-UCB<=0.55 => tier GO (integrate + publish); study-UCB>0.55 => tier quality NO-GO (publish negative); v2-screen-FAIL => stop now and publish speed-GO/quality-screen-STOP

demotions.v1_lpips_and_clip_tripwires: retained as diagnostics; reported alongside v2

diagnosis.band_narrowness: intrinsic bands were calibrated from n=4 full-decoder videos per cell (MAD scale near epsilon floors)
diagnosis.temporal_clip_degeneracy: temporal-CLIP distance is 1-cos between consecutive-frame CLIP feature deltas; for low-motion content these deltas are near-zero and direction is noise-dominated, so the 0.35 bound is not loose for this feature; violations appeared in ALL strata including near-static ones
diagnosis.texture_amplification: the tiny decoder's high-frequency texture differences perturb every frame-difference feature while LPIPS/CLIP identity remain clean

honesty_disclosure: Because v1 metric values are visible, NO redesigned metric rule chosen now can certify perceptual quality: any threshold is chosen with knowledge of the candidate's scores. The v2 screen therefore carries ROUTING authority only (whether the human study proceeds). The sole quality-claim authority for this tier is the pre-registered human study, whose data does not yet exist and whose analysis is frozen before any response. The v1 FAIL verdict remains permanently on record and citable.

human_study.authority: sole quality-claim authority for this tier
human_study.bundle_gate_amendment: tools/build_taew21_study_bundle.py accepts a v2 routing PASS (liveframe.taew21-metric-screen.v2 with passed=true) in place of a v1 verdict PASS
human_study.design_source: protocol human_study section + artifacts/taew21-study-power.v1.json (30 participants x 18 study trials + 2 attention + 2 repeat, 486 usable-judgment target)
human_study.primary_rule: one-sided 95% two-way cluster-robust upper confidence bound on discrimination accuracy <= 0.55

null_control.design: for each of the 32 campaign jobs, decode the job's full.mp4 (H.264 videotoolbox 8M, the exact medium study participants watch) back to raw uint8 frames and measure the three frozen pairwise instruments between pixels.full.bin and its own round-trip
null_control.purpose: a manipulation that is perceptually null AND identically present in both arms of the study; if it violates the v1 temporal bound, the v1 instrument is invalid by demonstration, independent of any tiny-decoder data

title: Metric-screen addendum v2: instrument diagnosis, null control, scale-referenced routing screen, human study as sole quality authority

v2_screen.ceiling: cross-content value: full video of job j vs full video of the next prompt in the same stratum and horizon (deterministic rotation over the 4 prompts per stratum), truncated to the shorter frame count when horizons pair unequal lengths (they do not: partner shares the horizon)
v2_screen.floor: same-job null-control value (full vs its own h264 round-trip)
v2_screen.on_fail: tier remains stopped; publish speed-GO/quality-screen-STOP as-is
v2_screen.on_pass: render the blinded study bundle and launch the pre-registered human study
v2_screen.rule: normalized position (d_tiny_full - floor_j) / (ceiling_j - floor_j) <= 0.5 for all three instruments on all 32 pairs; floor clipped below ceiling; a pair passes when the tiny decode is closer to the perceptually-null manipulation than to genuinely different content
v2_screen.rule_rationale: 0.5 is the midpoint principle (closer to null than to different-content), chosen as a structural constant rather than tuned to observed values; observed v1 raw values were visible when it was chosen, which is why this screen routes rather than claims

visibility_at_freeze.v1_metric_values: fully visible (tripwires 0.28-0.62 temporal-CLIP, LPIPS 0.016-0.116, CLIP 0.006-0.035; intrinsic band failures in all cells)
